name: Food / Editorial
displayName: 食物特写 · 莓好一刻
description: 真实生图素材与纸张、镜头聚焦和排字自由重组；通过新的草莓题材演示跨资源组合。

canvas.adaptation: Reference composition; reflow freely for 9:16 or 1:1. Not an automatic aspect converter.

audio.note: Silent concept preview. Narration, character, voice, language and speaking rate remain user-controlled.

dependencies.fonts: Operating-system Arial/Georgia/monospace; none bundled or fetched. Font metrics can vary across systems.

variants.name: 只研究微距
variants.recipe: preview.html?variant=macro；让同一张图片进入不同裁切与放大视野。可改为纹理研究，而不沿用本片文案。

variants.name: 只研究拼贴
variants.recipe: preview.html?variant=contact；将图片裁切与纸卡排布提取为独立工具，替换为当前项目的素材。

usage.remix: 先选择本次内容的视觉主角，再借用纸张、聚焦、曲线路径或排字中的少数方法。可全部重写场景。
usage.avoid: AI生成食品图不作为真实商品照片、营养或医学证据。
usage.motion: 8秒快速风格预览；examples/strawberry-remix 是24秒完整新题材重组示例。
usage.portrait: 重新设计主体裁切与文字位置，保留大物件和短句；横版等比适配不等于竖版成片。
usage.captions: 字幕独立安排，保留用户选择的旁白、人物、音色和语速。

provenance.creator: Short Video theme-pack contributors
provenance.scope: HTML/CSS/JS and SVG stamp; original composition using shared narrative poses

provenance.source: Native image generation tool in current session
provenance.note: Photographic-style AI material, not a captured photograph. Original prompt and source hashes retained. No third-party image downloaded.
